revisions.description: Initial draft based on Master Location requirement, screenshot and HTML mock-up (docs/master-location-rules.md) 29-Oct-26

objective: To add and maintain locations used in TC-PBR operations, each with a unique Location Alias (e.g. A1, A2, K1E) used as reference in delivery transactions.
To set the location point (latitude / longitude) using the map: address search, map click or marker drag.
To set the geofence radius used to check the driver position when closing a delivery, and whether delivery to the location can finish automatically (Auto Finish).
To deactivate locations already used in deliveries instead of deleting them, so historical deliveries keep their location reference.

operation.text: 5.1 Initial Display
Form blank (Add Mode); 'Location Sub Area' list from Sub Area master with '<Select an option>'; 'Auto Finish Order' = '<Select an option>'; 'Auto Generate Cycle' = No.
Map centred on the default area (TBD) without marker.
Location Registrations shows all locations (ACTIVE and INACTIVE) sorted by Location Code, 10 rows per page.
5.2 Map Operation
Key-in 'Location Address Google Map': show address suggestions (Google Places, TBD). No result: message no. 11. Typing 'lat, lng' offers that coordinate.

Select a suggestion / click the map / drag the marker: set Latitude and Longitude (7 decimals), move the marker, draw the Radius circle, and fill the Google Map address (from the suggestion or by reverse geocoding).
Typing Latitude / Longitude / Radius updates marker and circle. If the map service is not available, display message no. 12; coordinates can still be typed.
5.3 Save (Add / Edit)

items: If a mandatory field is blank, display message no. 1 on the field. Stop.
Check formats: Location Alias (no. 2), Latitude / Longitude range (no. 4), Radius > 0 (no. 5), Sub Area in master (no. 6), max lengths (no. 7). Stop on error.
Location Alias must be unique across ACTIVE and INACTIVE locations (no. 3).
Edit only: INACTIVE location or Alias change on a location used in delivery -> no. 8; record changed by another user -> no. 9.
Insert (Add) or update (Edit) in one DB transaction with audit fields, reset to Add Mode, refresh the list and display message no. 10.

operation.text: Backend validation must apply the same rules as the screen.
5.4 Options
View: show the location detail in a modal (read only).
Edit: load all fields into the form, centre the map on the stored coordinate and show the marker; Location Alias read only when used in delivery. Disabled for INACTIVE.
Deactivate (location used in delivery): confirmation no. 13; Status = INACTIVE, not selectable in new transactions, history keeps the reference. Message no. 16.
Delete (location never used): confirmation no. 14; physical delete. If it became used meanwhile, message no. 15.
5.5 Search, Kolom, Export
Search filters on Location Code, Name, Sub Area, Google Map Address, Physical Address (no data: message no. 17).
Kolom shows / hides columns. Export .xls exports all rows matching the search with the visible columns.
5.6 Geofence Rule (used by Driver App closing)

Distance between driver GPS and destination coordinate is calculated with the Haversine formula (Earth radius 6,371,008.8 m) or the geospatial function of the DB / service (TBD), not by comparing latitude / longitude directly.

Distance <= Radius: INSIDE GEOFENCE, closing follows the normal SOP. Distance > Radius: OUTSIDE GEOFENCE, show message no. 18 and record the event (delivery, location, GPS, distance, radius, time) for monitoring. The closing is not blocked.
Example: A2 Patimban, radius 100 m; driver at 65 m -> INSIDE; at 470 m -> OUTSIDE (warning).
5.7 Auto Finish Rule
Auto Finish Order is a per-location setting. When the delivery destination has Auto Finish = Yes and the TC-PBR Auto Finish trigger is met (TBD, OP-05), the delivery is finished without driver scan.
Audit for AUTO: finish mechanism = AUTO, finish timestamp, destination location, trigger latitude / longitude when available, SYSTEM. Normal closing by driver: mechanism = MANUAL/SCAN.
5.8 Security and Audit
Permissions (existing role framework): View, Add, Edit, Deactivate, Export Master Location. Buttons / options shown per permission.
Created By / At and Updated By / At filled by the system; history of deliveries keeps referring to INACTIVE locations.
